description: Plan 阶段步骤进度可视化：后端 emitProgress + plan_round_complete SSE 事件 + 前端 PlanProgressPanel 组件

tasks.title: Register plan_round_complete event type in all 4 sync points
tasks.description: Add `plan_round_complete` event type to: (1) `event-bus.ts` EventMap with payload `{ issueId, projectId, roundType, roundLabel, roundIndex, duration, verdict? }`, (2) `api/events.ts` ALL_EVENT_TYPES array, (3) `web/src/lib/types.ts` AgentDetailEventMap, (4) `web/src/lib/agent-events.ts` AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS, (5) `web/src/hooks/useSSE.tsx` eventTypes array. This is the foundational event registration that all other tasks depend on.
acceptanceCriteria: plan_round_complete is defined in event-bus.ts EventMap with issueId, projectId, roundType, roundLabel, roundIndex, duration, verdict? fields
plan_round_complete is in api/events.ts ALL_EVENT_TYPES
plan_round_complete is in web/src/lib/types.ts AgentDetailEventMap
plan_round_complete is in web/src/lib/agent-events.ts AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS
plan_round_complete is in web/src/hooks/useSSE.tsx eventTypes
Typecheck passes (cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit)
tasks.notes: Follow the exact same pattern as plan_round_start which already exists in all 4 locations. The verdict field is optional and only present for self-review/re-self-review rounds.

tasks.title: Wire emitProgress and plan_round_complete in runPlanStage
tasks.description: In `workflow-controller.ts` `runPlanStage()`: (1) Add duration tracking per round (Date.now at round start, compute diff at completion). (2) After each artifact round succeeds, call `this.emitProgress({ stage: 'plan', roundType, roundIndex, taskProgress: { completed, total: 5 } })` and emit `plan_round_complete` via EventBus. (3) After self-review PASS/FAIL, emit with verdict. (4) After auto-fix and re-self-review, emit similarly. (5) On checkpoint resume, call emitProgress once to reflect already-completed steps.
acceptanceCriteria: emitProgress is called after each artifact round with correct { stage: 'plan', roundType, roundIndex, taskProgress: { completed, total: 5 } }
plan_round_complete EventBus event is emitted after each round with { issueId, projectId, roundType, roundLabel, roundIndex, duration }
Self-review round emits plan_round_complete with verdict: 'PASS' or 'FAIL'
Auto-fix and re-self-review rounds emit plan_round_complete correctly
On checkpoint resume, emitProgress is called once with completedSteps reflected in taskProgress
Duration is recorded in seconds (Date.now diff / 1000)
GET /api/agent/status returns AgentProgress with populated roundType, roundIndex, taskProgress during plan stage
Typecheck passes (cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit)
tasks.notes: The emitProgress method already exists at workflow-controller.ts:95 but is never called from runPlanStage. Key call sites: after line 266 (artifact round success), after line 321 (self-review PASS), after line 322 (self-review FAIL), after line 360 (auto-fix complete), after line 421 (re-self-review complete), around line 125 (checkpoint resume). Duration tracking: store Date.now() before each round's prompt(), compute diff after.

tasks.title: Add planProgress state and SSE subscription to useSessionTimeline
tasks.description: In `useSessionTimeline.ts`: (1) Define `PlanStep` and `PlanProgress` interfaces. (2) Add `planProgress` state (`PlanProgress | null`). (3) Subscribe to `plan_round_complete` events via `onAgentEvent`: update step status to completed/failed with duration and verdict; append auto-fix/re-self-review steps on self-review FAIL. (4) Initialize planProgress from `agentStatus.taskProgress` on page load (when agent is running plan stage): mark steps 0..completed-1 as completed, step at roundIndex as running, rest as pending. (5) Return `planProgress` from the hook.
acceptanceCriteria: PlanStep interface has roundType, roundLabel, roundIndex, status, duration?, verdict? fields
PlanProgress interface has steps: PlanStep[], completedCount: number, totalSteps: number
plan_round_complete handler updates matching step to completed (or failed if verdict=FAIL) with duration and verdict
On self-review FAIL verdict, auto-fix and re-self-review steps are appended with status pending
planProgress is initialized from agentStatus.taskProgress when plan stage is active (5 base steps, 0..completed-1 = completed, roundIndex step = running)
planProgress is included in hook return value
plan_round_start handler also marks the corresponding step as running
Typecheck passes (cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit)
tasks.notes: BASE_STEPS = ['proposal', 'specs', 'design', 'tasks', 'self-review']. PLAN_ROUND_LABELS already exists at line 73 as ['proposal.md', 'specs/', 'design.md', 'tasks.json', 'self-review']. The agentStatus query is already set up at line 215 with 5s polling. Initialization: when agentStatus has stage='plan' and taskProgress, build initial steps. The plan_round_complete handler should also increment completedCount.

tasks.title: Create PlanProgressPanel component
tasks.description: Create `PlanProgressPanel.tsx` in `web/src/components/`. Render a list of plan steps with status icons (pending ○, running ● pulsing, completed ✓ green, failed ✗ red). Header shows `Plan Progress  X / 5 completed`. Each completed step shows human-readable duration (formatDuration helper). Self-review steps show verdict inline (PASS/FAIL). Visual style matches TaskProgressPanel (bordered panel with purple/blue tint).
acceptanceCriteria: PlanProgressPanel renders a list of steps with correct status icons: pending=gray circle, running=blue pulsing circle, completed=green check, failed=red X
Header displays 'Plan Progress  X / 5 completed' with correct count
Completed steps show duration in human-readable format (e.g., '2m 14s', '45s')
Self-review steps display verdict inline: 'self-review — PASS' or 'self-review — FAIL'
Auto-fix and re-self-review steps appear when appended
Component accepts planProgress prop matching PlanProgress interface
Visual style matches TaskProgressPanel pattern (bordered, colored background)
Typecheck passes (cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit)
tasks.notes: Follow the visual pattern of TaskProgressPanel at SessionTimeline.tsx:332-368. A formatDuration function already exists at SessionTimeline.tsx:17 but takes ms — we need a version that takes seconds. Consider extracting a shared util or adapting. Use the same rounded-lg border panel style.

(2) In SessionTimeline component, render PlanProgressPanel when `currentStage === 'plan'` and planProgress has steps, positioned at the same location as TaskProgressPanel (between PipelineStatusTimeline and RoundSection). (3) Pass planProgress from parent component (SessionDetail or IssueDetailPage) through to SessionTimeline.

PlanProgressPanel is rendered when currentStage === 'plan' and planProgress?.steps has entries
PlanProgressPanel is NOT rendered when currentStage === 'build' (TaskProgressPanel renders instead)
planProgress is passed from useSessionTimeline through to SessionTimeline component in the parent
Existing SessionTimeline rendering is not broken (rounds, TaskProgressPanel for build, RecoveryBanner all work)
